proposed_core.profile: Separate named Waite1922 text-only symbolic profile after original-page verification
proposed_core.inventory: Verify22 trumps plus56 suit cards,all78 unique stable IDs;four suits and court/rank aliases explicitly edition-specific. Source order and computational shuffle order are separate conventions.
proposed_core.meanings: Source-located upright/reversed entries with exceptions and alternative readings;direct versus compositional versus unsupported coverage. No generic LLM meanings or invented combined outcomes.
proposed_core.spread: Begin a documented manageable layout after checking original image/positions;Waite Celtic method includes a separate significator plus10 drawn cards. Do not silently call a simplified layout the exact historical procedure.
proposed_core.rights: Text-only first core;public-domain underlying source and modern deck art rights kept independent. Do not fetch/repackage current commercial card images.
proposed_core.output: Structured symbolic reading,source traces,positions,selected orientations,draw provenance and explicit limits;not factual predictions,diagnosis or hidden-personality detection.

randomization_audit.provenance: PRNG/digital shuffle is an explicit application adaptation,not a verified Waite ritual or a predictor of outcomes.
freeze_before_implementation: Canonical ordered deck IDs and profile version
Seed input type,UTF-8 encoding and normalization or explicit lack of normalization
Versioned PRNG algorithm,shuffle algorithm and byte/counter semantics;avoid environment-dependent built-in hash
Without-replacement Fisher-Yates or equivalent unbiased draw with rejection sampling where needed
Separate domain/stream for card orientations;explicit upright_only versus seeded reversal policy,no implied source-defined50-percent rate
Significator selection/removal and whether orientation consumes random state
Record seed,algorithm versions,deck order,positions and resulting orientations for replay
future_tests: Known-answer seeds checked independently of implementation
No duplicate cards,complete78-card permutation and draw-size limits
Orientation toggles must have documented effect on card sequence
Manual card selections and source fixtures kept separate from random draws

source_gaps: Original Waite scan title and diagram/per-card page verification before extracting rules
Do not infer meanings from modern retailer descriptions or blend Marseille/Thoth court/order conventions
Waite historical appearance/sex/age-based significator directions need attributed context;no automated appearance-to-personality assignment
Etteilla primary source/edition remains unresolved;do not spend disproportionate core effort on it
P1: Verified Waite78-card inventory/upright-reversed rules and independent fixtures
One source-located spread with source exceptions,or explicitly labeled practical adaptation
Freeze deterministic randomization contract,rights and scope before implementation
P2: Separate Marseille,Thoth and Etteilla profiles after direct procedural access
Additional documented spreads/correspondences and complex combinations
Optional licensed/public-domain original art only after rights/edition review
limitations: Symbolic traditions are not empirically verified outcome predictors. No Tarot implementation in this audit. Original60-technique taxonomy,54 retained techniques,rankings and excluded IDs25,27,41,42,47,48 unchanged.
